How it works

Learn. Nudge. Recommend. Act.

Four stages between your raw data and a confident call.

01

Learn

I connect to your existing stack through secure, read-only APIs and sync up to a year of history. No engineering effort, no workflow change.

02

Nudge

I correlate signals across channels, spend, and funnel stages around the clock, and flag what needs your eyes before you go looking.

03

Recommend

Every flag arrives with the cause, the options, and a recommended action in plain language, ranked by business impact.

04

Act

Approve, and I execute inside your connected tools. Every change is logged in a full audit trail.

Read-only by default. Nothing changes without your approval.
